    char ch,fu=0;
    for(ch='*'; (ch<'0'||ch>'9')&&ch!='-'; ch=getchar());

int n,k,MO,s,a[55],S[1000010];
LL pw(LL x,int y){
	LL t=1;
	for (;y;y>>=1){
		if (y&1) t=t*x%MO;
		x=x*x%MO;
	}
	return t;

	inv[n]=pw(fac[n],MO-2);

	int t=n;
	FOR(i,0,20){
		if (t&1) a[++s]=1<<i;
		t>>=1;
	}

					(f[i+1][j^k]+=f[i][j]*inv[S[k]])%=MO;
				}
			}
